REWORK verdict, 2026-08-29: "That definitely needs a re-do… it can be more modern, more transformative. Let's create three more sketches into this."

Three directions, each with its axis and its honest tradeoff. B leads because 'transformative' was the ask — it unifies house reports and vendor paper on one dated spine. Pick by elimination; the chosen one becomes the build behind mudavym_design_documents_reports.
